name: nv1-candidate-b-bounded-probe
description: Bounded probe of NV-1 candidate (b) conj:nv-as-bring-period-rank. Verifies primality of N_v=1,445,519 and computes minimum-irrep-multiplicity-decomposition counts in three S_5-relevant dim sets. Closed-form arithmetic only; not a substitute for the Bring period-lattice machinery.
caveat: This is a probe, not a closure. The full Bring-period-lattice machinery (Riemann period integration on y^2 = x^5 - 1) is research-grade open work and is not addressed here.
handoff: Bring-surface period-lattice computation remains open; see docs/audits/conjecture-cones.md and the candidate-(b) entry of docs/audits/2026-05-02-nv-frob-filter-conjectures.md.
scope_note: STRICT scope: closed-form arithmetic only, no DP arrays of size > 10^4.
